checks.question: Add a shaft connection to the supplied curved knob while preserving its entire exterior except the two specified openings. From its bottom plane at Z = 0, cut a D-shaped blind socket 10.0 mm deep. Its cross-section is a diameter-5.0 mm circle centred on the rotational axis, truncated by the flat plane X = +1.5 mm; remove only the region on the X ≤ +1.5 mm side of that plane. At Z = 8.0 mm and Y = 0, drill a diameter-2.0 mm radial set-screw passage from the positive-X exterior into the socket. Stop the radial cut after it reaches the socket; do not pierce the opposite outer wall. Preserve the organic outside silhouette, original height, pose and the closed top.
